title: The one who smiles at breakfast, dances in the kitchen, and takes a breath…
summary: Our kids don’t need a perfect mom — they need a happy one. The one who smiles at breakfast, dances in the kitchen, and takes a breath instead of breaking down.
caption: Our kids don’t need a perfect mom — they need a happy one. The one who smiles at breakfast, dances in the kitchen, and takes a breath instead of breaking down. They remember our laughter more than our to-do lists. 💛 And to be happy as a mom don’t forget to take care of yourself and your needs first. Fill your own cup before everyone else’s  #momlife #organizedmom #momroutine #momof3 #motherhood
